Photo 2: Top-down view of the body with lens attached, a battery pack labeled 'Nikon Rechargeable Li-ion', a 'Nikon Battery Charger', a rear body cap, a rear lens cap, and a separate lens cap printed 'TTArtisan APS-C 25mm F2.0'.
No photo shows the lens glass (front or rear element) uncapped.
No photo shows the rear LCD/EVF powered on, menu screens, or a shutter-count readout.
No photo shows the sensor with lens removed.
No photo shows a serial number plate or proof of ownership.

risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unknown/risk of defects

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or EVF/LCD may be faulty.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, showing LCD/EVF live view and a successful shutter press.
Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or a shutter-count checking app.
Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements without caps, under good light.
Photo of the sensor with the lens detached.
Photo of the body's serial number plate (usually on the base) for identity confirmation.
response.reason: The body is clearly identifiable as a Nikon Z fc with a TTArtisan 25mm F2.0 manual lens, so pricing is possible, but since shutter count, lens glass condition, and working power-on state are all unverified from the photos, the item must be priced at its worst-case condition until further proof is supplied.
